manufacturing.procedure: Take 1 Lit ML / 1Lit Water and Charge 1 Kg Caustic Soda Flakes, 1 Kg Crude Iodine in SSR under stirring.
Spurge Chlorine gas @ 2 Kg/Hr till pH 9.25 u00b1 0.25 is received.
Check Iodine Test. If OK, Maintain the reaction for 1 hr.
Drain the slurry in HDPE drums to settle for 4 - 6 hours, Sodium Para periodate formed.
Decant the upper layer & keep Sodium Paraperiodate slurry ready for centrifuge.
Centrifuge the reaction mass in parts. Wash the product with 1 Lit Tap water (If required).
Spin dry the product & give sample to QC for testing of Iodine Content and Assay. Complies / not complies.
Take 1 Lit Water and Charge 1 Kg Sodium Para periodate, in CR under stirring.
Charge 1Kg 58 u2013 60 % Nitric Acid till complete dissolution (Clear Solution).
Heat the solution to 80 u00b0C.
Stop stirring and settle the solution for 2 hrs.
Circulate the solution through the Gravity filter till clear solution is received. Clarity of the solution
Transfer the clear solution of the reaction mass to GLR.
Concentrate the solution up to Baume of 55 u2013 56.
Add 1 Lit Water to the above thick slurry.
Cool the solution to 60 - 70 u00baC.
Centrifuge the reaction mass in parts.
Spin dry the product & give sample to QC for testing of solubility and Assay. Complies / not complies.
If not complies, give 1 Lit D.M. Water washing to the product till QC test complies. Spin dry the product.
Unload the product in HDPE drums and load in RVD / Tray Dryer. Dry the product at 100 u00b1 5 u00b0C till the moisture content is less than 0.5 %.
Cool the dried product & give sample to QC for testing of moisture content and Assay. Complies / not complies.

Pass the material through 20 mesh and collect the material in clean HDPE container. Mill the lumps through Multi mill using 1.5 mm perforator and collect the material in HDPE drums and blend it with main product. Weigh the product - 1kg.
